Corphish

Water

Hoenn · Generation 3

Corphish is a Water-type Ruffian Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 11.5 kg. It evolves into Crawdaunt. Its highest base stat is Attack (80), with a base stat total of 308.
